With no Gate selection this also executes the verify commands declared by every work package, which for a large plan is dozens of external commands and minutes of wall time; narrowing with --gate, --stage or --all-gates runs only the selected Gates and skips them. Every one of those commands runs in this same working tree, one after another, so a verify command must be safe to re-enter: a suite that writes to a fixed scratch path, or asserts wall-clock throughput, will fail here for reasons that have nothing to do with the code under test. --field takes one value out of the result and prints nothing else, addressed as a dotted path through data (for example gates.0.status, or blockedBy); repeat it to read several in one call.
